_note: Fence destruction (docs/fence-destruction.md Contract 5), the thin fences (plain, picket, wire): piece_hp of one piece and what one round does to the piece it stops on (bullet_damage). blast: radius = splash radius * radius_share, damage at the centre falling off linearly. ram: a vehicle that loses min_speed m/s to a thin fence in one tick: its momentum (mass * speed lost) against momentum_per_hp * the hit points left of the pieces its box touches (shifted probe_m along its velocity); more breaks them all and it goes on, less damages them and it stops. debris: the falling pieces on the clients; the rubble mode (fade or stay) is house destruction's. Walls (brick, stone, concrete) are house_destruction.json materials.
